# h3_dns_nameservers (Data Source)

The authoritative name servers of h3llo DNS (`ns1`..`ns4.h3llo.cloud`). Point the domain's NS records at the registrar to them; the zone is verified when the delegation is seen. Every `h3_dns_zone` also exports `nameservers`; this data source is for configurations that delegate before the zone exists. Requires the DNS API with `GET /api/dns/v1/nameservers` (h3dns v2).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Delegate the domain to h3llo DNS before (or without) creating the zone here,
# e.g. with the registrar's Terraform provider.
data "h3_dns_nameservers" "h3" {}

output "ns" {
  value = data.h3_dns_nameservers.h3.nameservers # ["ns1.h3llo.cloud", ...]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Constant `h3dns`
- `nameservers` (List of String) Name server host names, in order
- `verification_txt_label` (String) Label of the TXT record used for `verification_method = "txt"` (`_h3dns-verification`)
